description: Search published books and artbooks on Artbook Society. Every keyword must match the title, subtitle, description, an author or contributor, the publisher or the edition type. Optional filters: price range, signed, numbered, limited edition, language.

language.description: Language of the text, ISO 639-1 code (for example fr or en).

max_price.description: Maximum price in the currency shown in results.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the currency shown in results.

query.description: Keywords (at most 8), in English or French. Each keyword must match. Optional when a filter is given.

name: search_products
title: Search books
